nodes.purpose: Extract onset, loudness and centroid features from an audio buffer, as one struct and as scalar ports.
nodes.summary: Measures beats, loudness and brightness of the sound.
nodes.tip: Use to get beat and loudness signals from the music.
nodes.title: Audio features
nodes.useWhen: After capture; feeds drift and bounce.

inputs.description: The audio buffer to split into bands.
inputs.name: buffer

params.description: Upper edge of the bass band; mid starts here.
params.label: Bass ceiling
params.name: bassMaxHz

params.description: Lower edge of the treble band; mid ends here.
params.label: Treble floor
params.name: trebleMinHz

nodes.purpose: Bass, mid and treble loudness (band RMS, like audio.features rms) as Float outputs.
nodes.summary: Measures bass, mid and treble loudness separately.
nodes.tip: Use to react to one part of the sound.
nodes.title: Audio bands
nodes.useWhen: After capture, to drive brightness, color or motion from one frequency range.

inputs.description: Audio features that speed the drift up on beats.
inputs.name: features

params.description: Drift's starting hue in degrees; unset picks a random pair (null in graph.json).
params.label: Fixed hue
params.name: fixedAnchorHue

params.description: Idle drift speed in degrees per second (today's audio.driftBaseRateDegPerSec).
params.label: Drift base rate
params.name: driftBaseRateDegPerSec

params.description: How much spectral centroid speeds or slows the drift (today's audio.centroidStrength).
params.label: Centroid strength
params.name: centroidStrength

params.description: Pitch spread normalizing the centroid nudge (today's audio.centroidRangeHz).
params.label: Centroid range
params.name: centroidRangeHz

nodes.purpose: Slow palette drift; outputs the live anchor hue as an Angle.
nodes.summary: A color that slowly wanders over time.
nodes.tip: Use to give a music effect a gently changing base color.
nodes.title: Palette drift
nodes.useWhen: After features; wire the anchor into audio.bounce.

inputs.description: Audio features whose onsets trigger the bounce.
inputs.name: features

inputs.description: The anchor hue the bounce moves around.
inputs.name: anchor

params.description: Beat hue damping time constant (today's audio.bounceSmoothTime).
params.label: Bounce smooth time
params.name: bounceSmoothTime

params.description: Minimum swing fraction even for the weakest onset (today's audio.dynamismFloor).
params.label: Dynamism floor
params.name: dynamismFloor

params.description: HSV saturation of every generated color (today's audio.vibrancySaturation).
params.label: Vibrancy saturation
params.name: vibrancySaturation

params.description: Brightness ceiling before loudness scaling (today's audio.vibrancyValue).
params.label: Vibrancy value
params.name: vibrancyValue

params.description: Loudness mapped to full brightness (today's audio.referenceRms).
params.label: Reference RMS
params.name: referenceRms

params.description: Darkest output when quiet (today's audio.brightnessFloor).
params.label: Brightness floor
params.name: brightnessFloor

params.description: Loudness damping time constant (today's audio.brightnessSmoothTime).
params.label: Brightness smooth time
params.name: brightnessSmoothTime

nodes.purpose: Beat-driven color bounce around the drift anchor; outputs a Color.
nodes.summary: Beat-driven color that jumps around a base color.
nodes.tip: Use for color that pulses with the music's beat.
nodes.title: Beat bounce
nodes.useWhen: After features and the drift anchor; the audio path's color output. Re-seeds (snaps) when audio.drift re-seeds, so set the fixed hue on audio.drift only.
